title: The BIAS Detection Framework: Bias Detection in Word Embeddings and Language Models for European Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using multiple metrics: WEAT and SEAT (cosine similarity of word/sentence embeddings between gendered terms and career/family or math/science/arts attributes), LPBS (log probability scores of gendered pronouns with attributes in masked language models), and CrowS-Pairs (pseudo-log-likelihood of stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical sentences).
